subject: Priv expansion: multi-zone seeding & pricing alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Eric Henderson <eric.henderson@therawell.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Priv expansion: multi-zone seeding & pricing alignment

Hi Eric —

Congrats on the Q4 rollout metrics you shared last week. As you head into your renewal window, I want to get ahead of the private environment expansion you mentioned on the call (multi-zone seeding for DR + an isolated analytics cluster).

Quick summary of what Redwood recommends and what we want to lock in for the renewal:
- Add two additional private clusters (one warm standby in us-west-2, one analytics-only in us-east-1)
- Extend committed term to 24 months to preserve preferred pricing on reserved nodes
- One-time setup for network peering and Vault KMS binding

I've attached an updated mutual action plan (TheraWell_MAP_v3.pdf) and a draft SOW that outlines cutover windows and validation gates. Would you be available for a short sync tomorrow to confirm cutover constraints and procurement timelines?

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0168
Attachment: TheraWell_MAP_v3.pdf (pdf), SOW_TheraWell_draft.docx (docx)

From: Eric Henderson <eric.henderson@therawell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: TheraWell Procurement <procurement@therawell.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Priv expansion: multi-zone seeding & pricing alignment

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with what we discussed internally. A couple quick asks from procurement before we move to an internal approval:
1) Can you confirm the SLA uplift and whether the analytics cluster is covered under the same availability SLA or a reduced SLA?
2) We need a ballpark of the one-time onboarding engineering hours so we can scope a PO.

I can do a 30-min sync tomorrow at 11am PT. I'll loop in our infra lead if needed.

—Eric
VP, Infrastructure — TheraWell Systems
Attachment: none

>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, TheraWell Procurement <procurement@therawell.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Priv expansion: multi-zone seeding & pricing alignment

Eric —

Quick answers before our sync:
- SLA: The analytics-only cluster will be offered at a "standard private" SLA (99.5% monthly) — it can be upgraded to the "business" tier (99.9%) for an incremental charge. I'll include both options in the MAP.
- One-time onboarding: estimate 120 engineering hours for network peering, KMS binding, and validation runbooks; 40 hours for staging and pre-cutover testing. We can compress with a weekend cutover but that increases change-window costs.

I've updated the MAP with a pricing-summary (see attached pricing-summary-qty-breakdown.xlsx) and a SOW section that calls out the SLA options. If procurement prefers a single PO line, we can consolidate the one-time services into the committed term as a capped implementation fee.

See you at 11am PT. Final link in calendar.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: pricing-summary-qty-breakdown.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Priv expansion: multi-zone seeding & pricing alignment (internal)

Looping in cost ops notes for the proposed 24mo commit with two extra clusters:
- Reserved node discount tier: move to 18-node tranche to keep unit price at current rate; incremental annualized savings ~18% vs pay-as-you-go
- If we fold the one-time onboarding into the ARR (cap implementation fee over 12 months), the customer qualifies for a 5% consolidation discount on services.
- SLA uplift to 99.9% adds ~12% to recurring cluster charges for the analytics cluster.

Proposed price motion: keep base renewed term at the current unit price, add analytics cluster with optional SLA line item, and apply consolidation discount if onboarding is capitalized.

Neha
Director, Commercial Ops

[Internal only — do not share pricing spreadsheet externally until legal signs off on the PO language]

- Acceptance criteria and rollback plan are in §3.2 of the SOW
- Planned maintenance blackout windows: Saturdays 02:00–06:00 PT (we can negotiate)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/abcd-therawell-sign

Kimberly Park
